import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# 1. Load gene expression data
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Remove version suffixes from Ensembl IDs
expr.index = expr.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0].values

# 2. Load mutation data
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', usecols=['bcr_patient_barcode'])

# 3. Define Ensembl IDs for BRCA1 and BRCA2
ens_map = {
    'BRCA1': 'ENSG00000012048',
    'BRCA2': 'ENSG00000139618'
}

# 4. Subset expression for BRCA1 and BRCA2
en_ids = list(ens_map.values())
expr_sub = expr.loc[expr.index.intersection(en_ids)]
expr_sub = expr_sub.rename(index={ens_map['BRCA1']: 'BRCA1', ens_map['BRCA2']: 'BRCA2'})
expr_sub = expr_sub.T  # samples x genes

# 5. Compute DNA repair signature score
df_sig = expr_sub[['BRCA1', 'BRCA2']].copy()
df_sig['DNA_repair_sig'] = df_sig.mean(axis=1)

# 6. Compute TMB per patient
tmb = mut.groupby('bcr_patient_barcode').size().rename('TMB')

# 7. Merge signature score with TMB
df = df_sig[['DNA_repair_sig']].join(tmb, how='inner')
df = df.dropna()

# 8. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(df['DNA_repair_sig'], df['TMB'])
print(f"Spearman correlation: rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3e}")

# 9. Scatterplot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.regplot(x='DNA_repair_sig', y='TMB', data=df,
            scatter_kws={'s': 30, 'alpha': 0.6}, line_kws={'color': 'red'})
plt.xlabel('BRCA1/2 Repair Signature (mean log2 FPKM)')
plt.ylabel('Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB)')
plt.title('Correlation of DNA Repair Signature with TMB')
plt.text(0.05, 0.95, f"Spearman rho = {rho:.2f}\np = {pval:.2e}",
         transform=plt.gca().transAxes, verticalalignment='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 10. Display a sample of the merged data
print("\nSample of merged data (first 5 rows):")
print(df.head())
